payload.description:
# HITL packets for published Pilobolus

## Done when

- Each published article has a read-only scan packet (JSON + finding list) from latest origin/main.
- A decisions template lists finding ids with no pre-filled skip/rewrite.
- A Pilobolus rewrite skill exists (VOICE constraints: no house name, no not-A-it's-B stacks, no invented facts).
- After Ryan records decisions, options + compare can run without touching published files until apply.
- Provenance can be composed (scan, decisions, options, compare, models).
payload.title: HITL packets for published Pilobolus
